name: Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Serum 100ml | India
description:
Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Serum – 100ml
Origin: Bangladesh

Revive and repair damaged hair with Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Serum. Infused with the powerful Vita-Oils Repair Complex, this serum combines avocado, sunflower, macadamia, and musk rose oils with antioxidant Vitamin E to nourish, strengthen, and protect your hair from breakage and damage.

Key Features & Benefits:

Reduces Damage: Up to 14x less hair breakage and significantly improves tensile strength.

Smooth & Soft Hair: Reduces cuticle lifting for softer, smoother strands.

Hydration & Repair: Deeply moisturizes hair and helps minimize split ends.

Nourishing Vita-Oils Complex: A fusion of 4 oils plus Vitamin E restores shine, smoothness, and suppleness.

Proven Results: Tested under controlled conditions, part of the Vitariche Repair Max range including shampoo, masque, and serum.

Size: 100ml

Transform dull, dry, and damaged hair into soft, silky, and revitalized strands with Streax Professional Vitariche Care Repair Max Serum.
